sections.title: Local mode and Online mode
sections.body: Local mode runs everything on your device and uses only the built-in SnapWell recipe book. Online mode adds AI-generated recipes and this assistant, powered by Google Gemini. Switch on the Home screen, or tap the mode badge at the top of any screen. The first time you turn on Online mode, SnapWell shows a short notice about what is sent. Switching modes clears the current recipe list and the chat, so recipes are worked out again for the new mode.

sections.title: Privacy and what leaves your device
sections.body: Your photos never leave your device: ingredient recognition and label reading both run on the device. In Online mode, your ingredient list (names and quantities), your preferences and your chat messages are sent to Google Gemini to power AI recipes and the assistant. Looking up a product barcode sends only the barcode number to Open Food Facts. Local mode sends nothing for recipes or chat.

sections.body: Local mode runs everything on your device and uses only the built-in SnapWell recipe book. Online mode adds AI-generated recipes and this assistant, powered by Google Gemini. Switch on the Home screen, or tap the mode badge at the top of any screen. The first time you turn on Online mode, SnapWell shows a short notice about what is sent. Switching modes clears the current recipe list and the chat, so recipes are worked out again for the new mode.

sections.title: Privacy and what leaves your device
sections.body: Your photos never leave your device: ingredient recognition and label reading both run on the device. In Online mode, your ingredient list (names and quantities), your preferences and your chat messages are sent to Google Gemini to power AI recipes and the assistant. Looking up a product barcode sends only the barcode number to Open Food Facts. Local mode sends nothing for recipes or chat.

verdict.text: Local mode runs everything on your device using the built-in recipe book without sending data, while Online mode uses Google Gemini for AI-generated recipes and this assistant. You can switch between them easily right from the Home screen or by tapping the mode badge at the top of any screen.

text: Local mode runs entirely on your device using pre-installed data, meaning it works without an internet connection and keeps your recipe searches private. Online mode connects to our cloud servers in real-time, giving you access to a constantly updated database of new recipes and trending ingredients like your chicken, rice, and broccoli. While Local mode is great for offline kitchen use, Online mode provides the most diverse and up-to-date cooking suggestions.

raw.answer: SnapWell scores recipes by how many of their ingredients you already have, while filtering out any that clash with your dietary preferences or allergies. In Online mode, Gemini can also generate custom recipes around your ingredients if your recipe-book matches fall below seventy percent. You can tap the Discover tab to explore your recipe matches.

sections.title: Recipe details and missing ingredients
sections.body: Tap a recipe card to see its ingredients and steps. The missing ingredients page lists what you still need, with search links to Coles and Woolworths for each one, and the nutrition page shows the recipe's figures per serving.

sections.title: How recipes are recommended
sections.body: SnapWell scores each recipe in its recipe book by the share of that recipe's ingredients you already have, after removing recipes that clash with your allergy, diet and meal-type settings; health goals and cuisine break ties. The percentage on each card is that match. In Online mode, when the best recipe-book match is below 70%, Google Gemini generates recipes around your ingredients instead, and those cards are marked Online. If the online service cannot be reached, you see the recipe-book matches.

raw.answer: SnapWell calculates nutrition figures itself using AUSNUT 2023, the Australian food composition database, based on per-100g values and standard portion weights. The app shows these figures per serving in the recipe details so you can easily see what you're getting.
